title: Dead Drop
tagline: Winter, 1963. A spy card game: drop in secret, flip together, call the bluff.
pitch: Run a network of agents against rival services: each turn you both drop an agent in secret, the cards flip together and their tricks go off. Escalate to double the stake and dare your rival to fold, while the Microfilm gives the side that loses a round a way back. Climb a ladder of five rivals, each with an announced twist and new agents and cities to recruit (20 of each in all), or play a friend online or on one device.
controls: Tap a card, then a city, then Lock in. Keys: 1–7 pick a card (or an Accomplice's partner), A S D a city, V face up or down in Casablanca, Enter locks in, E escalates, F folds.
